gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that getSpecifier returns the correct encoding descriptor for a RunCodec with an extremely large k value (Integer.MAX_VALUE) and BYTE1 as both sub-code
ADDED i2: BYTE1 is the standard single-byte codec used as both sub-codecs of the RunCodec
ADDED i3: Create a RunCodec with the maximum possible k (run-length threshold), using BYTE1 for both the "A" (run) and "B" (remainder) portions
ADDED i4: Pass the RunCodec as its own default so neither sub-codec is suppressed (since BYTE1 != the RunCodec, both sub-codec specifiers are included)
ADDED i5: Expected layout: [first=124, kx=524286, aSpec=1, bSpec=1] first = 117 + kb(3) + 4 (kx != 3) + 8*abDef(0) = 124 kx = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 4096 - 1 = 524286 aSpec
